```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
library(bis620)
library(reticulate)
use_condaenv("bis620", required = TRUE)
```



```{r create new class bis620_numpy_matrix}
np <- import("numpy", convert = FALSE)
setOldClass("numpy.matrix")
setClass(Class = "bis620_numpy_matrix",
         slots = c(pymatrix = "numpy.matrix")
         )


# create a new bis620_numpy_matrix object x1

x1 <- new("bis620_numpy_matrix", 
          pymatrix = np$matrix(list(c(0, 4.3, 0, 0, 0, 0),
                                    c(0, 5.6, 0, 0, 0, 0),
                                    c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0),
                                    c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0),
                                    c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 7),
                                    c(10, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0))
                              )
)

```


```{r set operator + for class bis620_numpy_matrix}

setMethod(
  f = "+",
  signature = c(e1 = "bis620_numpy_matrix", e2 = "bis620_numpy_matrix"),
  definition = function(e1, e2){
    
    a <- py_to_r(e1@pymatrix)
    b <- py_to_r(e1@pymatrix)

    if (ncol(a) != ncol(b) || nrow(a) != nrow(b)){
      stop("Two matrices have different dimentions.")
    }
    
    return(a + b)
    
  }
)


setMethod(
  f = "+",
  signature = c(e1 = "bis620_numpy_matrix", e2 = "matrix"),

)
```


```{r set operator / for class bis620_numpy_matrix}

setMethod(
  f = "/",
  signature = c(e1 = "bis620_numpy_matrix", e2 = "bis620_numpy_matrix"),
  definition = function(e1, e2){
    
    a <- py_to_r(e1@pymatrix)
    b <- py_to_r(e2@pymatrix)

    if (ncol(a) != ncol(b) || nrow(a) != nrow(b)){
      stop("Two matrices have different dimentions.")
    }
    
    c <- a / b
    c[is.na(c)] <- 0
    return(c)
  
  }
)

  f = "/",
```

```{r test}

set.seed(1)
x2 <- matrix(rnorm(36), ncol = 6)

library(Matrix)
set.seed(1)
x3 <- Matrix(rnorm(36), ncol = 6)

x4 <- sparseMatrix(  
  i = c(1, 1, 3, 6), 
  j = c(2, 3, 5, 1), 
  x = c(4.3, 5.6, 7, 10),
  dims = c(6, 6)
)

# Test that the following are correct:
x1 + x1
t(x1) %*% x1
x1 %*% x1
x1 + t(x2)
x1 %*% x2
x3 + x1
x3 %*% x3
x1 + x4
x1 %*% x4

```
